The parenthetical "(from DMR)" signals a monitoring/reporting source distinction; interpreting whether TDS is subject to numeric effluent limits or is report-only DMR monitoring changes whether compliance comparison applies (A) and whether DMR submission itself is the operative obligation (B).

The pH entry states separate maximum and minimum bounds rather than a single Max/Avg pair; interpreting these as enforceable numeric limits vs application measurements affects how reported pH values are compared for compliance (A).
